title: Dinner at Home
text:
In our house, dinner is at seven o'clock. My father cooks soup and rice. We sit together at the table. Everybody talks about the day.

I like the soup, but I do not like fish. My sister likes fish very much. After dinner, we eat fruit. My favourite fruit is a banana.

questions.text: What time is dinner in the house?
What food does the writer not like?
How does the family probably feel at dinner?
Why does the writer probably eat fruit after dinner?

vocabulary.definition: the main meal of the day, eaten in the evening
a warm liquid food made from vegetables, meat, or fish
a piece of furniture with a flat top, used for eating

paragraph_translations: En nuestra casa, la cena es a las siete. Mi padre cocina sopa y arroz. Nos sentamos juntos a la mesa. Todos hablan sobre el día.
Me gusta la sopa, pero no me gusta el pescado. A mi hermana le gusta mucho el pescado. Después de la cena, comemos fruta. Mi fruta favorita es el plátano.
